# Collapsible One panel that opens on demand. ## Usage ```gx

Hidden content.

 ``` The panel uses the native `
` element. The panel height animates in a browser that supports `interpolate-size`. Other browsers open the panel at once. The panel has no spacing of its own. Put the spacing on the content. ## Do - Use it for one optional block of content. - Put a verb in the summary. ## Don't - Do not hide essential content. - Do not use a collapsible for a list of questions. Use an accordion. ## Keyboard | Key | Action | | --- | --- | | Tab | Moves focus to the summary. | | Enter, Space | Opens or closes the panel. |
